Privacy Policy

Last updated: August 2026

1. Information We Collect

SolarSite Texas collects property addresses, homeowner contact information (for scheduling purposes), utility bill account numbers, CAD layouts, and on-site photographic documentation submitted by Solar EPCs, contractors, and field surveyors.

2. How We Use Project Information

All project data collected is used solely for the operational dispatch of certified field site surveyors, internal engineering quality assurance, and generating CAD-ready deliverable packages for the submitting contractor.

3. Data Security & Confidentiality

We implement enterprise-grade encryption for all stored project files, utility bills, and single-line diagrams. We never sell, rent, or distribute project leads, homeowner data, or contractor client lists to third-party marketing companies.

4. Contact Us

For questions regarding data retention or privacy practices, reach our operations desk via our contact page or call +1 (682) 396-0543.

Statewide solar site survey coordination platform connecting solar EPCs and installers with verified local surveyors across Texas. Delivering standardized field measurements and CAD-ready deliverables.
